senses.gloss: ch. same; (interrog.) where? Targ. Gen. IV, 9; a. e.—
units: Y. Yoma VIII, 44ᵈ bot. אן מן הדה (read … מן אן) wherefrom this? i.e. where is your authority? Y. Yeb. XII, 12ᵈ bot. ההן סבא לְאָן ליך of what use is this old man to thee?; a. e.—(relat.) where, wherever.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 27:6">Lev. R. s. 27</cite> beg. <he>א׳ את יהיב וכ׳</he> (<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 727:1">Yalk. Ps. 727</cite> <he>הן</he>) wherever thou givest, thou givest abundantly.
